responsibility: Provides RTL operand predicates for the RL78 machine description, especially where the generic GCC predicates are too strict for this target. It defines tests for volatile memory operands, near versus far operands, stack-based and increment/decrement-capable memory forms, small integer/immediate classes, comparison operator families, AX/addw-specific register operands, and symbol-based word operands, so that rl78 expanders and insn patterns can recognize RL78-valid operands independently of the lower-level constraint strings.
